answer: Put Dilithium signature binding proof at the door and most farms never get in: the check itself is the filter. One honest agent clears the check in 14 minutes; a farm of 454 pays 6356 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The hollow sits in the mechanism itself, the anchor sits in the price of faking it, and the echo sits in the record no template can forge. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
